rounds.method_summary: Hard-example proposal selection (max LPIPS disagreement per class group) paired with early-scale-biased time sampling (power law t=U^2.5). 256 samples x 4 proposals = 1024 generated, 256 selected. Uniform weighting. First evaluation attempt failed with INFRASTRUCTURE_RUNTIME error; recovered by trusted backend reusing original frozen checkpoint to regenerate all 50000 samples and compute independent FID. No retraining, no re-submission — this is evaluation recovery of the same method, not an additional method round.
